caveats: Straight-line distance between published points; proximity is not connection, capacity or feasibility.
The shared nearest transmission node is a screening grouping of points nearest the same NESO ETYS node; it says nothing about any feeder, connection offer or queue position.
Blank REPD capacity is unknown, never zero: MW sums are over stated values; unknown-capacity counts are given beside them.
Data-centre IT load MW and grid connection MW are separate source figures and never derived from each other; unclassified_mw is not summed as demand.
A data-centre pipeline entry is not a commitment; data-centre status is the baseline's own status field.
REPD status groups: operational = Operational; under_construction = Under Construction; consented = Awaiting Construction; in_planning = Application Submitted or Appeal Lodged.
REPD refs 18561 and 18562 carry known wrong coordinates and are excluded from all geography.

Live REPD records repeating one site (same technology, site name, stated capacity and point) are counted once: the most advanced status, then the highest Ref ID; the manifest lists every collapsed ref.
A data-centre point outside UK WGS84 bounds is treated as unplaced (never re-projected or guessed).

cell.mw_stated: sum of stated Installed Capacity (MWelec); blanks excluded
cell.count_mw_unknown: projects in the cell whose capacity is blank (unknown, not zero)

fields.precision: baseline location.precision; proximity_reliable is true for exact_site and settlement
fields.region_inferred: majority REPD Region of the 15 nearest located onshore REPD records (any technology or status); an inference, not a source field
fields.it_load_mw / grid_connection_mw: baseline values as published; null is unknown
fields.unclassified_mw (+label): passed through, never summed: the label says what the figure is
fields.radii[<km>][<tech>][<status>]: cell of REPD projects within <km> straight line
fields.nearest_by_technology[<tech>]: nearest REPD project of that technology in the four live status groups
fields.nearest_transmission_node: nearest located NESO ETYS node (connection-points.v3, >=132 kV)
fields.shared_node: live REPD projects (four technologies) whose own nearest ETYS node is the same node

repd_datacentre_proximity_{solar,battery.key: ref (REPD Ref ID); gg_project_id from the V6 identity
repd_datacentre_proximity_{solar,battery.layout: columnar (columns + rows) with the same columns as the CSV, for size; one file per technology part
repd_datacentre_proximity_{solar,battery.scope: solar, battery, onshore and offshore wind with usable coordinates, every status (status_group null outside the live pipeline); ordered solar, battery, wind onshore, wind offshore, then ref

fields.duplicate_of: set when this live record repeats a site (same technology group, normalised site name, stated capacity and point); the record named is counted instead and this one is in no radius or roll-up
fields.nearest_datacentres: up to 3 nearest proximity-reliable data centres
fields.within[<km>]: proximity-reliable data centres within <km>: count, operational, pipeline (every other status), stated IT load MW and grid connection MW with the number of sites stating each

evidence_classes.A_same_site_and_operator: strict operator match and <= 1.0 km, data centre at exact_site precision
evidence_classes.B_operator_match: strict operator match at any distance (dcmerge norm_operator after dropping a parenthesised gloss; exact equality; ';' splits several operators)
evidence_classes.C_same_site_name_and_proximity: >= 2 shared site-name tokens, at least one distinctive (in <= 10 REPD name+address strings), and <= 2.0 km
evidence_classes.D_same_site_proximity: <= 0.5 km, data centre at exact_site precision; any REPD technology or status
evidence_classes.E_repd_text_mentions_datacentre: REPD Site Name or Address mentions a data centre; paired with the nearest proximity-reliable data centre, which may be far away (evidence.nearest_within_name_match_km says whether it is within 2.0 km): the REPD text is the evidence, the pairing is only a pointer

colocation_candidates.json.note: a candidate is evidence to review, not a confirmed relationship

rollup_region.json.levels: region (REPD Region; data centres by region_inferred) and country
rollup_region.json.repd: live-pipeline cells of the four technologies

rollup_cluster.json.clusters: single-linkage of proximity-reliable data centres at 10 km, at least 3 sites; ids by size then member id
rollup_cluster.json.repd_within_km_of_any_member: live REPD projects within <km> of any member, each counted once
rollup_cluster.json.largest_consented_within_25km: the 5 largest stated-capacity Awaiting Construction solar and battery projects within 25 km of any member (unknown capacity last)

files.CSV files: flattened views of the JSON files: columns r<km>km_<tech>_<status>_{mw,count,mw_unknown}; blank cell = null
